info.title: Rithum DSCO Universal API
info.description: Rithum DSCO provides commerce operations APIs for suppliers and retailers to manage orders, inventory, catalog data, shipments, invoices, returns, warehouses, trading partners, conversations, shipping labels, and related marketplace workflows.

dscoOrderId.description: DSCO order ID. Provide this or poNumber or supplierOrderNumber to identify the order.

poNumber.description: Purchase order number. Provide this or dscoOrderId or supplierOrderNumber to identify the order.

supplierOrderNumber.description: Supplier order number. Provide this or dscoOrderId or poNumber to identify the order.

shipments[].description: Array of shipment objects to add to the order.

shipments[].lineItems[].description: Line items included in the shipment.

shipments[].trackingNumber.description: Carrier tracking number for the shipment.

shipments[].lineItems[].quantity.description: Quantity of this line item included in the shipment.

shipments[].lineItems[].lineNumber.description: Order line number for the shipped item when needed to disambiguate the item.

shipments[].lineItems[].sku.description: SKU of the shipped item. One item identifier is required on each shipment line item.

requestId.description: DSCO request ID for the small batch shipment request.
